game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Molten Bridge Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge, a bridge over magma: the ember mage must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before magma slimes spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge: a bridge over magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Molten Bridge, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before magma slimes spring the trap. Each round, magma slimes strike the cooling vent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the cooling vent from magma slimes in Molten Bridge: keep the predictions meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: predictions drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Molten Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 57 seconds while predictions > 0.
